cases.note: Issue #370. U+E000 encodes as EE 80 80 and U+1F600 as F0 9F 98 80, so GNU ls lists the BMP name first in both C and C.UTF-8 locales, which is also Python's code-point order. TypeScript's default comparator comes from UTF-16 code units, where the surrogate D83D outranks E000, and listed them backwards.
The same ordering through find's traversal, which sorts entries independently of ls.
